title: 806SA-0140 - Bluetooth receiver
type: Pohony brán, závory / Ovládanie pohonov / Wifi / Came
description_html:
Wi-Fi Gateway for CAME Connect Access System - Model 806SA-0200

Model: The 806SA-0200 is a modern device designed for access control via Wi-Fi connection in collaboration with the CAME Connect system or as a local Bluetooth selector. This gateway offers a flexible solution for effective and secure access control, allowing convenient and intuitive control of automated devices.

Main Features:

  • Connection to CAME Connect: Allows access and control of automation systems via the internet, enabling remote control and management of systems from anywhere.
  • Bluetooth Selector: In local mode, it functions as a Bluetooth selector, allowing simple control directly from a mobile device without the need for an internet connection. The AutomationBT app allows quick and efficient control via Bluetooth.
  • Support for 50 users: The device can manage up to 50 different users, making it ideal for small businesses or residential areas where access management for multiple people is required.

Technical Specifications:

  • Operating temperature: -20°C to +70°C, making the device suitable for both indoor and outdoor environments.
  • Protection rating: IP30, providing basic protection against dust and small objects.
  • Wi-Fi frequency: 2400 / 2483.5 MHz, ensuring stable wireless connection.
  • Wi-Fi transmission power: 13 dBm, sufficient for reliable coverage within the network.
  • Storage temperature: -25°C to +70°C, meaning the device is resistant to extreme conditions during storage or transport.
  • Average lifespan: 100,000 hours, guaranteeing long-lasting durability and reliability.

Installation and Configuration:

The device is designed for easy installation. Before connecting to the control unit, power and batteries must be disconnected. The Wi-Fi gateway connects directly to the electronic control unit via the [KEY] or [RSE] connector using an adapter.

Operating Modes:

  • Wi-Fi Mode: When first powered on, the device is set to Wi-Fi mode, ready for configuration using the CAME Connect Setup app. Through Wi-Fi, you can link the device to your home network and manage it remotely.
  • Bluetooth Mode: The device can also be set as a Bluetooth selector, allowing direct control of automation without the need for an internet connection.

Simple Configuration: For easy Wi-Fi connection, you can use the WPS (Wi-Fi Protected Setup) technology. Simply press the mode change button three times, and the Wi-Fi LED will start blinking rapidly, confirming WPS activation. Then press the WPS button on your router to complete the connection.

The Connect Setup app is available for iOS and Android, allowing easy configuration of the device and connection to your CAME Connect account. For Bluetooth selector mode, you can use the AutomationBT app, which is also available on the Google Play Store and Apple Store.

Conclusion: The Wi-Fi Gateway CAME Connect model 806SA-0200 is a powerful and flexible solution for access control and automation. Its dual functionality as a Wi-Fi access point and Bluetooth selector makes it ideal for a wide range of applications, from homes to small businesses.

The connection of the handle and transition (knee) is simple, a glued joint is used to adhere the materials.

type: Hliníkové brány a ploty / SWING-SHADOW
description_html:
Anthracite Aluminum Horizontal Tilting System Set 2.28 × 1.64 m with 1.5 m Anthracite Aluminum Rhombus Infill 20×105 mm, in Anthracite Aluminum Frame 50×60 mm
Product Code: FG/SWS-AL-L1-FR-SET1

A complete set of a modern horizontal tilting system designed for the production of elegant infills and shading systems. The construction consists of a sturdy 50 × 60 mm aluminum frame in Anthracite RAL 7016 finish. The system's infill comprises 20 × 105 mm aluminum rhombus slats in Anthracite RAL 7016 finish, ensuring a modern look, high strength, and optimal shading, complemented by an aluminum tilting mechanism, also in Anthracite RAL 7016 finish, allowing for regulation of airflow and privacy.

The system is designed for quick, weld-free assembly, by screwing with A2 fasteners. The aluminum profiles made of EN AW-6063-T6 material ensure high resistance to corrosion, moisture, and weather conditions. The powder-coated surface finish guarantees long-term color stability, UV resistance, and a modern matte appearance without the need for additional maintenance.

The construction allows for easy disassembly and replacement of individual parts during modifications or damage.

Advantages:

  • modern horizontal tilting system
  • sturdy 50 × 60 mm aluminum frame
  • rhombus aluminum slats 20 × 105 mm
  • standard maintenance
  • high resistance to corrosion and weather conditions
  • UV stable powder coating RAL 7016
  • simple and quick assembly without welding
  • possibility to regulate shading and privacy
  • elegant matte design suitable for modern fences and shading.
  • aluminum tilting components for higher system strength and longevity.

Set Components:

  • 2 pcs FG/PC20x8-6000-R7016

title: Aluminium Double-Leaf Gate 3.92x1.85 m with Rectangular Slat Infill 20x100, Anthracite R7016 - with SWING Drive - SET
type: Hliníkové brány a ploty / Hliníkové brány / Hliníkové dvojkrídlové brány
description_html:
Aluminium Double-Leaf Gate 3.92 × 1.85 m, passage 3.995 m with rectangular slat infill 20 × 100 mm – Anthracite RAL 7016 – with SWING-3024-Smart drive with photocells – SET
Product code: FG/S-DSG-R7016-GA-SET

Modern and maintenance-free solution for your entrance
This modern double-leaf gate represents an ideal solution for vehicle entrances, emphasizing long lifespan, minimal maintenance, and timeless design. It is made of high-quality extruded aluminium EN AW-6063 T6, which provides high strength at low weight and significantly better corrosion resistance than common steel structures. The dominant element is the rectangular slat infill 20 × 100 mm, which ensures a modern look, optimal privacy, and an elegant architectural style. The powder coating in the popular shade Anthracite RAL 7016 (matt) guarantees long-term color stability without fading or peeling.

Automatic SWING-3024-Smart drive with photocells included
The set includes a modern SWING drive for automatic opening of the double-leaf gate, ensuring comfortable and reliable daily use. The drive allows for easy control via remote control and also supports SMART control through a mobile application. The gate can be conveniently controlled remotely using a smartphone, which brings higher comfort, security, and simple daily use.

Why choose this gate?
If you are looking for a modern, maintenance-free, and customizable gate with high durability, this system represents a long-term more advantageous investment than cheaper steel alternatives. Its advantages include a good price/quality ratio, the purchase of a complete set, easy installation without welding, a modular solution, and installation without visible screws. The system can be expanded in the future with identical fence panels.

Key competitive advantage
Unlike welded constructions, the system is fully bolted without welds, which provides:
• higher processing precision
• easier installation
• simpler custom adjustments
• possibility of disassembly without damaging the structure

Technical parameters
• max. gate width: 3923 mm
• clear width between posts: approx. 3995 mm
• max. height: 1850 mm
• infill dimension: 20 × 100 mm
• color finish: Anthracite RAL 7016 (matt)
• drive type: SWING-3024-Smart with photocells, for double-leaf gates
• control: remote control + SMART application

Custom flexibility without surcharges
The gate can be adjusted directly on site by shortening profiles and infills according to specific requirements, which reduces the costs of individual production.

Maintenance-free solution for many years
The combination of aluminum and stainless steel fasteners ensures that the gate:
• does not rust
• does not require painting
• retains its functionality and appearance for many years

Complete solution in one set
The gate is supplied including hinges and the SWING drive, ready for immediate installation without the need to purchase additional components.

Universal use
The double-leaf gate is suitable for:
• family homes
• gardens
• commercial properties

Thanks to its modern design, quality workmanship, and automatic drive, it will ensure a functional, safe, and aesthetic entrance to your property.

Main advantages
• automatic SWING drive included
• SMART control via mobile application
• convenient opening and closing of the gate with a smartphone
• high corrosion resistance
• color stability without the need for painting
• easy installation without welding
• possibility of custom adjustment
• minimal maintenance – just regular cleaning

Combination of aesthetic and functional design

title: Aluminum carport 5300x3000 R7016
type: Hliníkové brány a ploty / Hliníkové prístrešky
description_html:
Premium aluminum carport with dimensions of 5.3x3 meters – the ideal way to cover a parking space. Due to its parameters, it can also serve as a pergola for your outdoor seating area.

The very strong and stable construction in anthracite RAL 7016 with a matte finish fits any space and does not require drilling into the wall. The carport is made of high-quality aluminum with a powder-coated finish, ensuring resistance to weather conditions. Each post measures 15x15 cm, making it strong and durable in any weather. The roof is made of sturdy sandwich panels with PU foam, offering excellent user properties. Thanks to this, the roof has a load capacity of up to 100 kg/m2. In case of heavy snowfall, it is recommended to remove the snow regularly. The top side of the panels is anthracite, matching the rest of the structure, while the underside is white to maximize light under the carport. Water drainage is handled by a unique integrated system within the structure. This drainage system helps prevent damage to your car’s paintwork and reduces dirt buildup, saving you time on car washing.

Any side of the pergola can be complemented with a wall made of WPC panels. These sturdy panels provide additional enclosure and enhance the overall properties of the carport or pergola.

The robust post measures 150x150 mm, and during installation, the base plate with dimensions of 194x194 mm must be considered. The base plate is made of 8 mm thick steel and is additionally covered with an aluminum cap with an integrated drainage system. The PRESTIGE aluminum carport protects your car or outdoor seating area from rain, snow, hail, and sun. In summer, it prevents the car from overheating, while in winter, it eliminates the need to scrape ice from the vehicle.

Thanks to its excellent properties, detailed workmanship, and modern design, the PRESTIGE carport fits perfectly with modern buildings with clean lines. Its design closely resembles bioclimatic pergolas, allowing you to match the appearance of outdoor structures on your property.

Professional 305 mm aluminum cutting blade for mitre and crosscut saws. Thanks to its precise processing and thin 2.4 mm cutting edge, it provides a clean, smooth and precise cut without burrs. Ideal for cutting aluminum profiles, frames, strips and non-ferrous metals such as copper or brass.

Technical parameters:
Disc diameter: 305 mm
Bore diameter (clamping): 30 mm
Cut thickness: 2.4 mm
Teeth material: carbide (HM)
Intended use: aluminum, copper, brass, plastic, non-ferrous metals
Application: mitre saw, chop saw

Advantages:
Extremely precise and clean cut without burrs
Long service life thanks to carbide teeth
Stable and quiet operation at high speeds
Minimizes overheating of the material
Ideal for professional and domestic use

Application:
Suitable for precise cutting of aluminum profiles, window frames, pipes and thin-walled structures. Ideal for carpentry, assembly and locksmith workshops, where the quality and accuracy of the cut are important.

If you are looking for a modern, maintenance-free, and flexible fencing solution, this system is an excellent choice. Compared to steel alternatives, it does not rust and does not require additional coatings.

Universal Use

This modern aluminium fence panel provides an elegant and practical fencing solution focused on long service life, minimal maintenance and a contemporary architectural appearance. Made from high-quality extruded aluminium, it offers excellent resistance to corrosion and adverse weather conditions, making it ideal for outdoor use without the need for regular maintenance.

The main feature is the vertical rectangular slat infill (20x80 mm) with 100 mm spacing, creating an airy and modern design with clean lines. The slats are fixed vertically to horizontal rails, which are then anchored to pre-installed posts using the B2/01-80x20-R9005 fixing system. This system ensures a strong and stable structure while maintaining a sleek minimalist appearance suitable for residential and commercial projects.

The powder-coated finish in Anthracite RAL 7016 (matt) ensures long-term colour stability without fading, cracking or peeling.

Why choose this fence?
If you are looking for a modern, maintenance-free and visually light fencing solution, this aluminium system is an ideal choice. Unlike steel alternatives, it does not rust, requires no regular repainting and maintains its premium appearance for many years.

Thanks to its modular system, the fence can be easily combined with other elements and adapted to specific project requirements.

Key Competitive Advantage
The bolted, non-welded system ensures precise manufacturing, easy installation and on-site adjustability. The structure also allows easy replacement or removal of individual components without affecting the rest of the fence.

Maintenance-Free Solution for Years
The aluminium structure combined with a high-quality surface finish ensures corrosion resistance, no need for repainting and long-lasting durability.

Universal Application
The fence panel is suitable for residential homes, modern buildings, gardens and commercial properties.

type: Hliníkové brány a ploty / Hliníkové výplne plotov a brán / Hliníkové plné výplne plotov a brán / Lamely model 17
description_html:
The 17 x 107 x 6000mm aluminium fence filler is ideal for creating full fences that offer maximum privacy and a contemporary look. With its 6000mm length, it can be easily adapted to a variety of lengths.

The fence filler is made from high quality aluminium EN AW-6060-T6, which provides high resistance to corrosion and weathering. It is specially designed for creating full fences, guaranteeing maximum protection and privacy. The slats are designed to be easily joined together to create a uniform and compact appearance with no visible joints or gaps. This flexible system allows you to create endless possibilities when designing different designs.

The infill is in natural finish, with no surface treatment. Although aluminium offers exceptional rust resistance, it is recommended that it is coated to prevent oxidation, which can change the appearance of the material and reduce its aesthetics over time. Aluminum can be finished with anodizing, powder coating, etc. to extend its life and maintain a modern appearance.

With a length of 6000mm, the infill is easily adaptable to different lengths, allowing for easy customised installation. Whether you need shorter or longer fence sections, this infill is extremely flexible.

title: Aluminum fence infill 40x40x1.2-6000mm
type: Hliníkové brány a ploty / Hliníkové výplne plotov a brán / Hliníkové výplne s medzerami medzi latami / Lamely model 40
description_html:
The 40x 40 mm aluminium fence filler with a length of 6000 mm is a great choice for modern fences that offer visual lightness, elegance and privacy. The gaps between the slats create a sleek, airy design that also allows light and air to pass through. This style is ideal for fences that complement modern family homes, gardens or commercial properties.

The fence infill is made from EN AW-6060-T6 aluminium, which is characterised by its exceptional resistance to corrosion and weathering, making the fence suitable for a wide range of climatic conditions. The finish adds additional protection against UV rays, rain and snow, extending the life of the infill. Aluminium infill does not rust, is low maintenance and retains its original appearance after years.

The infill is in natural finish, without coating. However, to ensure long-term protection from oxidation and to maintain aesthetics, it is recommended that it is coated. Aluminium can be surface treated by anodising, powder coating etc. Aluminum treated in this way will provide maximum protection against weathering, corrosion, while retaining its modern appearance without heavy maintenance.

Installation of this fence filler is simple and does not require welding, which greatly simplifies the installation process. With a length of 6000mm, the slats can be tailored to specific dimensions, providing flexibility when installing different types of fences.

This type of aluminium fencing is suitable for a wide range of applications - from fences around houses, to gardens, to commercial properties. The sleek, gapped design provides plenty of privacy, yet doesn't obstruct the flow of air or light, making it ideal for exteriors that need to combine functionality and aesthetics.

Kód produktu: FG/SWS-20x95-2400-AL-R7016

Kvalitná hliníková lamela určená pre naklápacie žalúziové systémy predstavuje moderné, odolné a bezúdržbové riešenie pre ploty, tienenie a zabezpečenie súkromia. Presný rozmer 20 × 95 mm a dĺžka 2,4 m umožňujú použitie v modulárnych systémoch s plynulou reguláciou sklonu lamiel.

Hliník je ľahký, pevný a prirodzene odolný voči korózii, čo zaručuje dlhú životnosť aj v náročných vonkajších podmienkach. Povrchová úprava práškovým lakovaním v odtieni Antracit RAL 7016 (mat) poskytuje vysokú UV stabilitu, farebnú stálosť a moderný technický vzhľad.

Použitie v naklápacích systémoch umožňuje flexibilnú reguláciu svetla, prúdenia vzduchu a úrovne súkromia, pričom si zachováva čistý a minimalistický dizajn vhodný pre modernú architektúru.

Kľúčové vlastnosti

Presný rozmer – kompatibilná s naklápacími systémami 20 × 95 mm
Odolný materiál – hliník s ochranou proti korózii
Bezúdržbové riešenie – bez potreby natierania
Vysoká stabilita – vhodné pre exteriérové použitie
Moderný dizajn – antracitové prevedenie RAL 7016
Kotvenie lamiel – horizontálne max. dĺžka 1 500 mm, vertikálne max. dĺžka 2 400 mm

Prečo si vybrať túto výplň?

Hliníkové lamely ponúkajú dlhodobú stabilitu, minimálnu údržbu a vysokú odolnosť voči poveternostným vplyvom. V kombinácii s naklápacím systémom umožňujú presné riadenie súkromia a tienenia bez kompromisov v dizajne.

Sú ideálne pre moderné ploty, brány, pergoly aj architektonické deliace prvky, kde sa vyžaduje čistý vzhľad a vysoká funkčnosť.

Technické parametre

Rozmer lamely: 20 × 95 mm
Dĺžka: 2 400 mm
Materiál: hliník (AL)
Povrchová úprava: práškové lakovanie
Farba: Antracit RAL 7016 (mat)
Určenie: pre naklápacie žalúziové systémy
Kotvenie lamiel: horizontálne max. dĺžka 1 500 mm, vertikálne max. dĺžka 2 400 mm

Výhody

vysoká odolnosť voči korózii a počasiu
dlhodobá farebná stálosť
bezúdržbová prevádzka
moderný a elegantný vzhľad
presná kompatibilita so systémami
nízka hmotnosť pri vysokej pevnosti
široké možnosti použitia v exteriéri

title: Aluminum post 1850mm, anthracite
type: Hliníkové brány a ploty / Hliníkové stĺpiky a profily / Model 70x70
description_html:
Material: aluminum.
Color: RAL7016.
Dimensions: 1850x70x70mm.

PRODUCT DETAILS
The aluminum post is an integral part of the modular fence, which ensures the strength and stability of the entire structure. These posts serve as supporting elements between which the slats are installed, creating an elegant and functional fence.
Standard heights of 1850 mm and 2500 mm are suitable for anchoring to a footing or into concrete. For individual needs and preferences, the posts can be shortened to any height, which allows the structure to be adapted to various terrain conditions and design solutions.
The posts are equipped with grooves that are compatible with our aluminum and wood-plastic slats. These grooves allow for easy and quick assembly of the slats without the need for welding. Overall stability is ensured by the fasteners that you screw directly onto the aluminum slat or onto the strip for wood-plastic slats. This will increase the overall stability and strength of the structure.
RECOMMENDED ACCESSORIES
For a complete installation of modular fencing, we recommend purchasing:
70x70 mm post cap
Aluminum post cover strip - to cover unused grooves.
Accessory post base with cap (In case of anchoring to a wall)
BENEFITS OF THE MATERIAL
Durability: Aluminum is resistant to corrosion and weathering, which guarantees a long service life of the posts without the need for repairs or maintenance
Lightweight: Aluminum posts are lightweight, which makes handling and installation easier. Therefore, the anchoring elements do not have to be robust.
Aesthetic appearance: Aluminum provides a modern and elegant appearance that fits with various fencing and architectural styles

type: Nerezové polotovary / Držiaky skla terče / Terče oblý tvar / Dvojbodový držiak

It is used for fixing glass panels to various structures such as railings, balustrades, doors or walls. They take the form of a flat plate with several point brackets on which the glass is placed. title: Anti-corrosion semi-matte paint, anthracite, 2,5L
type: Dom, záhrada, farby / Farby a patiny / Farby / Farby hladké
description_html:
Anthracite anti-corrosion semi-matt paint suitable for zinc and aluminum.
The paint is compatible with the spray J08/01-ANTHRACITE

WS-Plast® Thick Film M 4200 is a pure acrylate paint system which, due to its special composition, adheres to zinc and aluminum surfaces without any primer.
It is suitable for use as a duplex system (hot dip galvanizing plus coating) depending on the layer thickness and the ambient conditions for coating acc. to EN ISO 12944.
It is also suitable for coatings of hot-dip galvanized enclosures, gates, balcony railings, lamps, gutters, steel structures, blacksmithing, as well as non-anodized aluminum components such as porches, flagpoles, cladding, etc.
Always electrostatically adjusted. WS-Plast® thick film M 4200 can be rolled, sprayed or painted.

Surface preparation:
For hot-dip galvanized surfaces, aluminum surfaces, non-galvanized steel and old coatings, different pretreatments should be used. Please note the product data sheet and the processing information.

Application:
The processing can be done by brushing, rolling, conventional or airless spraying. All electrostatic methods are applicable. Stir well before use. For further information (dilution, injection pressure, etc.) please refer to the product data sheet and the processing information.
Drying time:
Dust-dry: approx. 20 minutes
Recoatable: approx. 1-2 hours
Touch proof: about 2 hours
Completely dry: about 1-2 days

Productiveness:
250 g per m2 result in 80my dry film = the recommended minimum layer thickness. When used near the coast and in road salt contaminated environment at least 160my are required.

description_html:
The Came BKV15AGE operator represents a new generation of automation for sliding gates, combining powerful performance with intelligent functions.
It is designed for intensive use, making it an ideal choice not only for larger private residences, but also for industrial facilities and apartment buildings.

Main advantages and technologies

Adaptive Speed Torque technology: This system continuously evaluates the weight and weather conditions (e.g. wind or friction), ensuring smooth movement and constant gate speed in all circumstances.
36 V DC motor with encoder: The 36 V motor enables safe and quiet operation with a high output of 200 W. The encoder ensures millimetre-precise deceleration before the end positions.
Fully graphic display: The ZN8 control unit is equipped with a display that significantly simplifies programming, diagnostics and management of up to 250 users.
Magnetic limit switches: Unlike mechanical switches, magnetic switches are more resistant to freezing and dirt, ensuring trouble-free operation even in demanding winter conditions.
Smart connectivity: Supports CAME CONNECT technology, allowing you to control and monitor your gate remotely via smartphone using the cloud.

Technical specification

  • Maximum gate weight: 1500 kg (750 kg recommended)
  • Maximum leaf length: 20 m
  • Travel speed: 12 m/min
  • Protection rating: IP54 (high resistance to dust and splashing water)
  • Motor power supply: 36 V DC
  • Operating temperature: -20 °C to +55 °C

title: BETA steel anchor d12, L40mm
type: Spojovací a kotviaci materiál / Kotvy
description_html:
Steel percussion-driven expansion anchor, suited for heavy duty fastenings on solid supports.

• Due to its small dimensions it's suitable for use on concrete members with narrow thickness or dense reinforcement
• Easy installation also in proximity of free edges and with reduced spacing
• Anchor expansion occurs thanks to the percussion of the internal steel cone, so it's independent from the screw tightening
• Suitable for fixings that require a threaded insert in the wall, in order to fix threaded studs, eyebolts, screws or hooks
• Ideal for works requiring threaded rod hangers on concrete ceilings for thermohydraulic plants, hanging pipes, cable holders
• Available in zinc-plated steel - with or without lip - and in stainless steel

Application
Suited for solid supports: concrete, stone. Designed for push-through fastening.

description_html:
The hydraulic brake is an essential component for the safe and reliable operation of sliding gates installed on slopes. This component prevents uncontrolled movement of the gate, ensuring user safety and protecting the gate's mechanism.

  • Safety and Control: The brake is designed to regulate the speed of the gate's movement during opening and closing, minimizing the risk of uncontrolled descent on the slope.
  • Durability and Reliability: The hydraulic system ensures long-lasting durability even in challenging conditions, making it suitable for outdoor installations.
  • Easy Installation: It is compatible with most sliding gates, allowing for easy integration into existing systems.
  • Smooth Operation: The brake ensures smooth movement of the gate without sudden stops or jolts, enhancing user comfort.
  • Dimensioning as Needed: The hydraulic brake is sized based on the height of the slope and the weight of the gate to ensure optimal efficiency and safety for every installation.

This hydraulic brake is the ideal solution for gates installed on steep slopes, where safety and precise movement control are a priority.

description_html:
Introducing the ATS-3-AGS drive, a top model from the Came brand, designed for swing gates with large and wide posts. The distance from the hinge axis to the edge of the post can be up to 200 mm. This version of the drive uses alternating current (AC), which brings several significant advantages for demanding users.

Advantages of the AC version:

  • Power and Stability: The AC drive provides constant power even under high load, ensuring reliable operation even for heavy and large gates, even in windy weather.
  • Durability and Long Life: AC motors are known for their robustness and durability, which means less maintenance and a longer lifespan for the entire system.
  • High Efficiency: AC drives operate with high efficiency, minimizing energy losses and ensuring efficient operation.
  • Easy Installation: The AC version of the ATS drive is designed for quick and easy installation, saving time and costs during assembly.
  • Compatibility with Various Installations: The AC drive is ideal for a wide range of applications, including residential and commercial gates, and is capable of operating in various climatic conditions.

Basic Features:

title: Chemical anchor 300ml, -20°C vinylester
type: Spojovací a kotviaci materiál / Chemické kotvy
description_html:
High-quality anchor based on vinyl ester resin without styrene with a special winter composition for applications at low temperatures down to -20 °C.
Provides secure fastening and high load values even on solid and hollow supports, also in wet holes and on wood.
Suitable for use with a cartridge gun and static mixer,
Temperature resistance up to +80 °C, short-term up to +120 °C.
The joint is waterproof, meaning water cannot penetrate into the hole through the adhesive mixture,
Suitable for fastening elements placed near the edge, as the anchoring does not cause any expansion,
Very high chemical resistance, Low odor: it is styrene-free,
The cartridge can be used until the expiration date by replacing the static mixer or resealing the cartridge with the sealing cap,
Storage temperature between -20 °C and 25 °C.
Shelf life from the date of manufacture: 18 months.

title: Concrete screw Zn, 10x90mm
type: Spojovací a kotviaci materiál / Kotvy
description_html:
Screw with CE marking and ETA assessment for cracked and non-cracked concrete. Seismic qualification in category C1 and C2 with high performance. Fire resistance up to 120 minutes.
High mechanical performance. High flexibility of use thanks to three different installation depths for each diameter. Thanks to the wide assortment, thicknesses of up to 95 mm can be fixed. A small minimum distance between anchors and a small minimum distance from the bottom edges. Smaller hole diameter and therefore shorter installation time compared to other anchoring systems. Possible adjustment after mounting the screw (the screw can be moved twice by up to 10 mm if the nominal anchorage depth is guaranteed).

PLA-15U – Front Console for Swing Gate Operators

PLA-15U is an innovative front console designed for swing gate operators. This product is the ideal solution for professionals looking for a quick and efficient installation without the need for welding.

  • Easy Installation: The console is designed for screwing, which significantly simplifies the mounting process. It allows for quick and secure fastening without complicated welding work.
  • Perforated for Precision: The specially perforated holes in the console allow for achieving the correct anchoring geometry, thereby increasing the stability and safety of the entire structure.
  • Universal Use: PLA-15U is compatible with various operator models such as Wingo, Toona, and Ray, making it very flexible and suitable for a wide range of applications.
  • Durability and Quality: Made from high-quality materials, the console guarantees long life and resistance to weather conditions.
  • Ideal for Aluminum Gates: Customers primarily use it for aluminum gates, where welding steel consoles is not possible.

PLA-15U is the perfect choice for anyone looking for a reliable and efficient solution for installing swing gate operators.

Main functions
Came Remote Protocol (CRP): Provides access to the protocol for remote control and management of automation systems.
Dual mode (Master-Slave): Enables synchronous control of two drives at the same time (e.g. for two opposite gates).
Easy integration: The card is inserted directly into the dedicated RSE connector on the main electronic control board.

Technical information
Compatibility: CAME drives and control units equipped with an RSE slot (e.g. BXV series).

description_html: A glass (sheet metal, plate) infill holder is a structural element used to fasten and stabilize glass or sheet infill in various constructions, such as railings, balconies or stairs. This holder ensures a firm and secure attachment of the filling, thus increasing the overall stability and safety of the structure. They are part of modern architectural solutions that combine functionality, safety and aesthetic appearance. When choosing a holder, it is important to consider its material, design, functionality and compatibility with a specific filling and overall construction. It serves as a corner joint to connect the infill, holding the infill (insurance against falling out) is achieved by means of a clamping joint (recommended use for top anchoring) or a clamping joint + safety pin (recommended use for lateral anchoring). The holder does not include a seal (necessity to buy 4 pcs of seals according to the thickness of the glass) and caps for the screws.

Bore diameter: 22.23 mm

Use: angle grinder (flexa)
Properties: durable, non-clogging, with high cutting precision
Advantages:
Fast and precise cutting without burrs
Reduces overheating of the material
Extended disc life
Suitable for long-term and precise cutting work
High safety at work
Application:

title: Design 3D sheet - Zn
type: Bránové a plotové systémy / Hliníkové výplne plotov a brán / Tabuľové výplne plotov a brán
description_html:
Regardless of the type of building, whether residential, industrial, or office, the exterior appearance is always perceived as a showcase.
Therefore, the decoration of the facade should not only combine technical features but also aesthetic values. Our offer includes various forms of wall surface treatment, including decorative panels and 3D panels.
Decorative 3D steel panels – redefine the field by adding sleek design and versatility in both interiors and exteriors.
They are made from high-quality galvanized sheet metal and offer a modern solution for architectural decorations, which can bring sophistication to spaces while also providing structural strength and weather resistance.
Whether these steel panels are installed as wall cladding, room dividers, gate or door fillings, or added accents, they seamlessly blend captivating style with utilitarian usefulness, allowing architects to create charming and unique spaces.

title: Diamond hole saw
type: Spojovací a kotviaci materiál / Náradie a prípravky / Vrtáky
description_html:
Diamantový vrták je nástroj používaný na prácu s krehkými materiálmi. Môže sa použiť na suché vŕtanie otvorov do povrchov, ako je sklo, keramické dlaždice, kamenina a mramor. To je možné vďaka diamantovému prachu na pracovných hranách tohto produktu. Diamantová dierová píla z rady PERFECT má šesťhrannú rukoväť, ktorú je možné použiť s väčšinou neúderového elektrického náradia. Umožňuje tiež veľmi rýchlu výmenu príslušenstva. Telo je vyrobené z jedného kusu ocele, vďaka čomu je nástroj veľmi odolný. Dierová píla je dostupná v niekoľkých priemeroch od 6 do 12 milimetrov.

VLASTNOSTI A VÝHODY
Diamantové vrtáky ponúkajú vysoký výkon, čo umožňuje rýchle a efektívne vŕtanie, ktoré šetrí čas.

Sú vysoko odolné a dajú sa opakovane použiť.

Pomáhajú znižovať riziko poškodenia materiálu vďaka presnému vŕtaniu bez úderov.

VLASTNOSTI:
Diamantové hrany
Telo vyfrézované z jedného kusu ocele
Plnené parafínom
Šesťhranná stopka
Na suché vŕtanie bez príklepu do skla, mramoru, žuly, kameniny a keramiky atď.

MATERIÁL VÝROBKU:
Uhlíková oceľ, diamant

POUŽITIE VÝROBKU:
Vŕtanie otvorov do keramiky a kameniny.

TECHNICKÉ ÚDAJE:
Priemer 10 mm;
Maximálna rýchlosť 2600 ot./min.

type: Nerezové polotovary / Al kotviace profily / Záslepky, tesnenia, kotvenie / Záslepky AL profilu
description_html:
This double sided tape consists of polyester film carrier, layered on both sides with a modified solvent acrylic adhesive.
It has a very good resistance against UV radiation, extreme temperatures, chemical, solvents and humidity, It is highly shear resistant adhesion has excellent durability when attached to metal, varnish and high energy surfaces.

title: Double-sided tape, t 3,0mm/12mmx16,5m
type: Nerezové polotovary / Hutný materiál, Madlá / Madlá na sklo / Hranatý tvar madla
description_html:
The total thickness of the tape is 3 mm, which consists of white closed polyethylene foam with a thickness of approx. 2940 micrometers. It is coated on both sides with approx. 40 micrometers of pressure-activated acrylic adhesive. The tape is covered with white or blue silicone paper. The color of the paper does not affect the quality of the tape. The diameter of the sleeve is classically 76 mm.
The tape is suitable for gluing most plastics, cardboard, laminate, treated wood, glass, but also metals, etc., note: we recommend AFT tapes for the highest stress. The glued joint resists UV radiation, moisture, eliminates thermal expansion and galvanic cells between different materials, dampens noise and vibrations. The temperature resistance of the tape is from -20 to +100 °C.
The tape is intended for general gluing, it can be used to glue complex cardboard packaging, window moldings, engraved labels and name tags, information boards, tread plates and covers. The tape has good adhesion to materials when gluing from 0 degrees °C !! Before use, carefully test the tape for your specific application.

type: Bránové a plotové systémy / Hliníkové brány / Hliníkové dvojkrídlové brány
description_html:
The double-leaf aluminium gate with dimensions of 3.92 x 1.85 m is a modern and elegant solution for your home. The door panel is made up of 20 x 100 mm slats separated by 20 mm gaps, ensuring a balance between privacy and light access. This design provides an elegant appearance and maintains an open atmosphere, which is particularly important in family homes and gardens.

Powder coated for long life
The door is coated with a durable anthracite powder coating (RAL 7016), which increases its resistance to mechanical wear, sunlight and adverse weather conditions. The textured surface not only adds aesthetic dimension but also ensures a long service life, minimising the need for regular maintenance. EN AW-6060-T6 aluminium, resists corrosion, ensuring that the gate retains its original appearance even after years.

Simple and quick installation - no welding
The gate is supplied as an assembly kit, which means that installation is quick and easy. It does not require welding, which simplifies the whole assembly process. For a list of the components included in the kit, please refer to the Parts section of the kit. The set does not include anchoring material.

Universal use
The double-leaf gate is a great choice for family homes, gardens and commercial buildings. With its modern design and quality craftsmanship, it will add a stylish and secure approach to your exterior. The combination of practical features and aesthetic appeal makes this gate ideal for everyone.

The dominant element is the rhombus louvered infill (20x105), which ensures optimal privacy, shading, and a modern architectural look. The powder coating in the popular shade Anthracite RAL 7016 (matt) guarantees long-term color stability without fading or peeling.

Why choose this gate?

If you are looking for a modern, maintenance-free, and adaptable gate with high durability, this system represents a long-term more advantageous investment than cheaper steel alternatives.

Good price/quality ratio, purchase of a complete set, easy assembly without welding, modular solution, and assembly without visible screws. A system that can later be expanded with identical fence panels.

Key advantage

•higher processing precision

•possibility of disassembly without damaging the structure

Custom flexibility, without additional charges:

The gate can be easily adjusted in width and height directly on site by shortening the profiles and infills, which significantly reduces the costs of individual production.

Maintenance-free solution for years:

Complete solution in one set:

Supplied including hinges, lock, cylinder insert, and fittings - ready for immediate assembly without the need to purchase additional components.

Universal use

The double-leaf gate is an excellent choice for family homes, gardens, and commercial properties. With its modern design and quality craftsmanship, it will provide a stylish and secure access to your exterior. The combination of practical features and aesthetic appearance makes this gate an ideal solution for everyone.

Advantages:
• complete set – all components in one package

title: Dowel screw with metric-and wood thread, stainless steel, AISI304, M10x100
type: Spojovací a kotviaci materiál / Skrutky / Skrutky kombinované
description_html:
Dowel screw, also known as a two-sided screw, has two different types of threads on both ends: a wood thread on one side and a machine (metric) thread on the other. Thanks to this unique design, dowel screws are ideal for joining two different types of materials.
They are used to connect metal elements to wooden surfaces, such as parts of stainless steel railings, load-bearing beams or metal fasteners for outdoor structures.

WiFi receiver designed for wireless control of devices exclusively through the internet network.

  • Control only via WiFi – does not support traditional remote controls
  • Easy connection to the home network using the DASPI application
  • Fast pairing by pressing the button on the receiver
  • Possibility of remote control via smartphone
  • By connecting the magnetic sensor MS-01, you get feedback on the gate status

description_html:
Galvanized Frame for Cantilever Sliding Gate 6x2.125 m, Unwelded, with Tensioner - Natural - SET - ECO 
Product code: ZN/FR-CLG-N-SET-ECO

The modern steel, galvanized, unwelded frame for a cantilever sliding gate represents a premium solution for property access without the need for a bottom track. Thanks to its cantilever design, the gate moves above the ground, eliminating problems with dirt, freezing, or track wear. It is an ideal solution for intensive use and demanding climatic conditions.
The frame is made of high-quality galvanized steel profile 60x40x2 mm, which after welding ensures high strength and exceptional corrosion resistance, with the possibility of further enhancement by subsequent painting. The structure is designed for long-term, maintenance-free operation with a recommendation for painting.
The main advantage is a universal frame ready for fitting your own infill according to the desired appearance, level of privacy, or architectural style.

Gate Dimensions
Maximum clear opening width 4500mm, maximum height 2125 mm.
The system is designed a cantilever gate with a galvanized steel C-profile 60x60. The frame is prepared for fitting an individually chosen infill according to customer requirements.

Why choose this gate frame?
If you are looking for a cost-effective, sufficiently strong, modern, reliable, and maintenance-free solution for a cantilever sliding gate with the option of your own infill, this system represents a long-term advantageous investment. It offers high durability, precise manufacturing, a complete mounting set, and maximum flexibility in creating the entrance design according to individual requirements.

Key Competitive Advantage
Unlike classic track systems, this frame is designed for a cantilever gate, which brings: trouble-free operation even in winter without snow and dirt in the track, minimal maintenance without cleaning tracks, quiet and smooth movement, higher reliability in daily use, the welded construction achieves high frame strength, easy infill installation and on-site adjustments with the possibility of infill disassembly.

Technical Parameters
max. gate width: 6000 mm
clear opening width: approx. 4500 mm
max. height: 2125 mm

Tailored Flexibility without Surcharges
The gate frame can be easily adjusted in width and height directly on site by shortening the profiles, which significantly reduces the costs of individual production and simultaneously allows for the installation of infill according to your own requirements.

Complete Solution in One Set
Supplied: galvanized profiles 60x60 for welding the frame, bottom guide, cantilever galvanized C-profile 60x60, top guide U profile 40x40 for welding to the frame, nylon wheel with bracket, top stop, nylon racks with Fe core, including tensioner with galvanized square profile 40x40.

Universal Use
The cantilever sliding gate frame is suitable for family homes, company buildings, industrial areas, and commercial premises. Thanks to the possibility of installing your own infill, it provides maximum flexibility in creating the entrance according to individual requirements and the architectural solution of the building.

Advantages
• complete ECO set for cantilever gate frame
• possibility of installing your own infill according to individual requirements
• high corrosion resistance
• possibility of further coatings at your discretion
• easy subsequent infill installation without welding
• possibility of custom adjustment
• high stability and long service life of the structure
• modular system - possibility of expansion with compatible fence panels

title: Galvanized Post 60x40-H1400 mm with Welded Base Plate and PVC Cap, Anthracite RAL 7016
type: Plotové systémy / Stĺpiky
description_html:
Galvanized Post 60x40-H1400 mm with Welded Base Plate and PVC Cap, Anthracite RAL 7016
Product Code: YAD01ZN1400X1,50/7016H

Steel fence post with a cross-section of 60×40 mm, with a welded steel base plate and a PVC cap. It is designed for mounting fence panels and other types of fencing on solid foundations, such concrete bases, low walls, terraces, parking lots, or other stable surfaces. The welded base plate allows for quick and easy anchoring of the post without the need for concreting.

Material
• Steel profile with Zn surface treatment.
• Steel base plate firmly welded to the post.
• PVC cap for finishing the post.

Surface Finish
• Zn surface treatment with subsequent powder coating in Anthracite RAL 7016 shade.
• Durable surface finish suitable for outdoor use.
• Increased resistance to corrosion and weather conditions.

Dimensions
• Post cross-section: 60×40 mm.
• Length: 1400 mm (1.4 m).
• Wall thickness: 1.5 mm.
• Base plate dimension: 100×100 mm.
• Anchoring holes: 4×12 mm.
• Recommended anchoring bolt size: M10.

Installation and Compatibility
• Designed for anchoring into solid foundations, such concrete bases, low walls, terraces, parking lots, or other stable surfaces.
• The welded base plate with 4 holes of 12 mm diameter allows for firm and stable attachment using suitable anchoring bolts or dowels.
• Recommended anchoring bolt size: M10.
• Suitable for mounting welded fence panels and other types of fence infills.
• Possibility of anchoring adapters:
  MODEL 20 (product code FG/AL20U...), MODEL 20PRO (product code FG/A20...), MODEL 20PV (product code FG/AT16...), MODEL 20/18/16/14 (product code FG/A20x14...), MODEL 20/22/24/26 (product code F/A20x26...), for infills with a width of 20 mm.
• Possibility of anchoring clamps (product code YAF01ZN04-01...) or clips (product code YAF01ZN04-01-02/7016-G) for attaching a welded fence panel (product code YAA01ZN0830x4,0...).

Advantages
• Solid steel construction with welded base plate.
• Quick installation without the need for concreting the post into the ground.
• Suitable for mounting on concrete foundations, low walls, and other solid surfaces.
• Zn surface treatment and powder coating ensure increased corrosion resistance.
• Modern anthracite RAL 7016 appearance.
• Universal use for various types of fencing.
• Supplied with PVC cap.

Galvanized Post 60x40 mm with Base and PVC Cap, 1800mm - Brown RAL 8017
Product code: YAD91ZN1800X1,50/8017Z

Steel fence post with a cross-section of 60×40 mm, with a welded steel base and a PVC cap. It is designed for mounting fence panels and other types of fencing on solid surfaces, such concrete foundations, walls, terraces, parking lots, or other stable surfaces. The welded base allows quick and easy anchoring of the post without the need for concreting.

Material
• Steel profile with Zn surface treatment.
• Steel base firmly welded to the post.
• PVC cap for finishing the post.

Surface finish
• Zn surface treatment with subsequent powder coating in Brown RAL 8017.
• Durable surface finish suitable for outdoor use.
• Increased resistance to corrosion and weathering.

Dimensions
• Post cross-section: 60×40 mm.
• Length: 1800 mm (1.8 m).
• Wall thickness: 1.5 mm.
• Base dimension: 100×100 mm.
• Anchoring holes: 4×12 mm.
• Recommended anchoring bolt size: M10.

Installation and compatibility
• Designed for anchoring into solid surfaces, such concrete foundations, walls, terraces, parking lots, or other stable surfaces.
• The welded base with 4 holes of 12 mm diameter allows for firm and stable attachment using suitable anchoring bolts or dowels.
• Recommended anchoring bolt size: M10.
• Suitable for mounting welded fence panels and other types of fence infills.
• Possibility of anchoring adapters:
MODEL 20 (product code FG/AL20U...), MODEL 20PRO (product code FG/A20...), MODEL 20PV (product code FG/AT16...), MODEL 20/18/16/14 (product code FG/A20x14...), MODEL 20/22/24/26 (product code F/A20x26...), for infills with a width of 20 mm.
• Possibility of anchoring clamps (product code YAF01ZN04-01...), or clips (product code YAF01ZN04-01-02...), or corner clamps (product code YAF01ZN03-60X40...), continuous (product code YAF01ZN01-60X40...), end (product code YAF01ZN01-60X40...), for attaching welded fence panels (product code YAA01ZN0830x4,0...).

Advantages
• Solid steel construction with welded base.
• Quick installation without the need for concreting the post into the ground.
• Suitable for mounting on concrete foundations, walls, and other solid surfaces.
• Zn surface treatment and powder coating ensure increased corrosion resistance.
• Modern anthracite look RAL 8017.
• Universal use for various types of fencing.
• Supplied with PVC cap.
• Minimal maintenance – regular cleaning is sufficient.

title: Gate 1pc. SQUARE ZnPVC 1000x1500mm, anthracite
type: Plotové systémy / Bráničky
description_html:
Výplň branky svařovaná síť. Rozměr oka 200x50mm. Průměr drátu 4mm. Profil sloupků 60x60x2mm.Výška sloupků 2000mm.Profil rámu 40x40x1,5mm.Povrchová úprava: zinek + RAL 7016 antracit.
Součástí balení je také zámková část a klika.


VLASTNOSTI PRODUKTU

Naše kovové branky jsou vyrobeny z odolných materiálů, které zaručují, že vydrží dlouhá léta. Elegantní design a jednoduchý vzhled těchto branek z nich činí ideální volbu pro rezidenční i komerční nemovitosti. Ať už si chcete zřídit moderní vstup na hřiště, zahradu nebo i minimalistický vstup k vašemu dvoru nebo firmě, tato branka naplní vaše očekávání.


Kromě vysoké kvality jsou tato vrata cenově přijatelná, díky čemuž jsou dostupné širokému spektru zákazníků.


DETAILY PRODUKTU

Jedním z hlavních prvků této branky je výplň tvořená svařovanou sítí, která poskytuje dostatečnou pevnost a odolnost. Výplň zachovává estetiku a transparentnost, ale také přispívá k propustnosti vzduchu a světla, což je důležité zejména pro zahradní prostředí.

Branky jsou pozinkovány a stříkány práškovou barvou, která zaručuje dlouhodobou ochranu před korozí a povětrnostními vlivy. Díky této povrchové úpravě si branka zachovává svůj vzhled i při dlouhodobém používání.

Z naší nabídky si můžete vybrat barevné varianty: zelená RAL6005, antracit RAL7016 a černá matná RAL9005. Výška branky se pohybuje od 1000 mm do 2000 mm. Šířka branky je standardně 1000 mm.
Před instalací branky si prosím zkontrolujte přechodové a osové rozměry, které se mohou lišit v závislosti na typu křídla, závěsů a zámkové části. Součástí branky je také kompletní zámková část, klika, cylindr s klíči, doraz a panty.


DOPLŇKOVÉ INFORMACE

Branky jsou oboustranné (pravá/levá) a výběr směru otevírání je přizpůsoben vašim preferencím. Stačí otočit zámek a doraz.
Při montáži oplocení na sloupek branky doporučujeme použít příchytku typu Strong.


Branka je dodávána s prodlouženými sloupky, které při betonování do země poskytnou dostatečnou stabilitu.


Ať už hledáte estetické doplnění pro vaši zahradu nebo praktické řešení pro zabezpečení vaší nemovitosti, ocelová branka je skvělou volbou.

title: Gate 1pc. SQUARE ZnPVC 1000x1800mm, green
type: Plotové systémy / Bráničky
description_html:
The gate infill is made of welded mesh. Mesh size 200x50mm. Wire diameter 4mm. Post profile 60x60x2mm. Post height 2300mm. Frame profile 40x40x1.5mm. Surface treatment: zinc + RAL 6005 green. The package also includes the lock part and handle.


PRODUCT FEATURES

Our metal gates are made from durable materials that ensure they last for many years. The elegant design and simple appearance of these gates make them an ideal choice for both residential and commercial properties. Whether you want to create a modern entrance to a playground, garden, or even a minimalist entry to your yard or business, this gate will meet your expectations.


In addition to high quality, these gates are affordably priced, making them accessible to a wide range of customers.


PRODUCT DETAILS

One of the main features of this gate is the infill made from welded mesh, which provides sufficient strength and durability. The infill maintains aesthetics and transparency, but also contributes to air and light permeability, which is especially important for garden environments.

The gates are galvanized and powder-coated, which ensures long-term protection against corrosion and weather influences. Thanks to this surface treatment, the gate retains its appearance even with long-term use.

You can choose from our range of color variants: green RAL6005, anthracite RAL7016, and black matte RAL9005. The height of the gate ranges from 1000 mm to 2000 mm. The width of the gate is standardly 1000 mm.
Before installing the gate, please check the passage and axial dimensions, which may vary depending on the type of wing, hinges, and lock part. The gate also includes a complete lock part, handle, cylinder with keys, stopper, and hinges.


ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

The gates are double-sided (right/left) and the opening direction is adapted to your preferences. Simply rotate the lock and stopper.
When installing fencing to the gate post, we recommend using the Strong type clamp.


The gate is supplied with extended posts, which provide sufficient stability when concreted into the ground.


Whether you are looking for an aesthetic addition to your garden or a practical solution to secure your property, a steel gate is a great choice.

description_html: The point holder for the glass infill is a special structural element that serves to fasten the glass infill to the frame or structure without the use of traditional bar holders. These holders are usually shaped like a round or square tip that is fixed into the substrate and holds the glass with a small contact point. They provide a minimalist look as they do not require extensive moldings or frames to surround the glass. This design allows maximum use of light and openness of space, which is ideal for modern and minimalist architectural applications. They are mainly used in interior and exterior applications such as railings, balustrades, doors, walls and other structures where a modern and elegant appearance is desired.

type: Nerezové polotovary / Držiaky skla osové / Osové držiaky oblé / Model 20
description_html: A glass (sheet metal, plate) infill holder is a structural element used to fasten and stabilize glass or sheet infill in various constructions, such as railings, balconies or stairs. This holder ensures a firm and secure attachment of the filling, thus increasing the overall stability and safety of the structure. They are part of modern architectural solutions that combine functionality, safety and aesthetic appearance. When choosing a holder, it is important to consider its material, design, functionality and compatibility with a specific filling and overall construction. Full holding - insurance against falling out is achieved using a clamping joint (recommended use for top anchoring) or a clamping joint and safety pin (recommended use for side anchoring). The holder does not include a seal (need to purchase 2 seals according to the thickness of the glass) and screw caps.

description_html: A glass (sheet metal, sheet) infill holder is a structural element used to fasten and stabilize glass or sheet infill in various constructions, such as railings, balconies or stairs. This holder ensures a firm and secure attachment of the filling, thus increasing the overall stability and safety of the structure. They are part of modern architectural solutions that combine functionality, safety and aesthetic appearance. When choosing a holder, it is important to consider its material, design, functionality and compatibility with a specific filling and overall construction. Full holding - insurance against falling out is achieved using a clamping joint (recommended use for top anchoring) or clamping joint + safety pin (recommended use for side anchoring). The holder does not include a seal (need to purchase 2 seals according to the thickness of the glass) and screw caps.

type: Nerezové polotovary / Držiaky skla osové / Osové držiaky oblé / Model 22, 25
description_html:
A glass (sheet metal, sheet) infill holder is a structural element used to fasten and stabilize glass or sheet infill in various constructions, such as railings, balconies or stairs. This holder ensures a firm and secure attachment of the filling, thus increasing the overall stability and safety of the structure. They are part of modern architectural solutions that combine functionality, safety and aesthetic appearance. When choosing a holder, it is important to consider its material, design, functionality and compatibility with a specific filling and overall construction. Full holding - insurance against falling out is achieved using a clamping joint (recommended use for top anchoring) or clamping joint +safety pin (recommended use for side anchoring). 
SET4 contains 4 pcs of glass holder in disassembled state + 8 pcs of screws A2 DIN7991 M6x15 + 8 pcs of gray PVC caps to cover screws A2 DIN7991 M6x15 + 4 pcs of screws A2 DIN 7380 M8x20. The holder does not contain a seal (necessity to purchase 2 seals according to the thickness of the glass).

description_html: The glass infill point holder is a special construction element used to fix the glass infill to the frame or structure without the use of traditional bar holders. These holders are usually in the shape of a round or square spike that is fixed into the substrate and holds the glass using a small contact point. They provide a minimalist look as they do not require extensive mouldings or frames to surround the glass. This design allows for maximum use of light and openness of space, making them ideal for modern and minimalist architectural applications. They are particularly used in interior and exterior applications such as railings, balustrades, doors, walls and other structures where a modern and elegant look is desired. The FLEX1 point bracket allows the distance of the bracket from the wall to be adjusted before the glass is mounted, making it possible to compensate for unevenness during installation.

description_html: The holder for glass (sheet metal, panel) infill is a structural element used to fasten and stabilize glass or sheet metal infill in various constructions, such as railings, balconies, or staircases. This holder ensures a firm and secure attachment of the infill, thereby increasing the overall stability and safety of the structure. They are part of modern architectural solutions that combine functionality, safety, and aesthetic appearance. When selecting a holder, it is important to consider its material, design, functionality, and compatibility with the specific infill and overall structure. The retention of the infill—protection against falling out—is achieved by means of a clamping joint (recommended for top mounting), or a clamping joint + pin (recommended for side mounting), or a clamping joint + safety plate (recommended for side mounting). The holder does not include a gasket (it is necessary to purchase 2 pieces of gasket according to the thickness of the glass) and screw covers.

title: GSM controller 9-36V DC
type: Pohony brán, závory / Ovládanie pohonov / GSM (mobilom)
description_html:
The MP/GSM-230-2G is an advanced GSM receiver designed for remote control of gate drives, lighting, and other electrical devices using a mobile phone. This device uses the 2G GSM network to provide reliable connectivity and control of devices without the need for physical access.

Key Features:

  • Remote Control via GSM: Allows for opening and closing gates or controlling other devices via phone call or SMS.
  • Compatibility: Can be connected to a wide range of gate drives and other electronic devices.
  • Easy Installation: Supports power supply range of DC 9V – 36V. The package includes a power supply that can be used if the drive does not have a suitable output for powering the GSM receiver.
  • Status Indicators: LED indicators for showing connection status, relay function, and GSM signal strength.
  • Security: Access is only possible for authorized users stored in the device's memory. Up to 200 users can be stored, who are authorized to open the gate.
  • Relay Mode: The device can control relays, allowing connection of various devices, including lighting, irrigation systems, and more.
  • Easy Reset: Option to reset to factory settings using a button.

Technical Specifications:

  • Power Supply: DC 9V – 36V
  • GSM Frequency: 2G (GSM) connection
  • Relay Output: NO, COM, NC (switch contact)
  • Control: Remote control via call or SMS
  • Security: Authorized access for stored numbers (up to 200 users)

The MP/GSM-230-2G is an ideal solution for anyone looking for a reliable and simple way to remotely control their devices via the GSM network. Its easy installation and wide compatibility make it suitable for both residential and commercial applications.

title: GSM control of gates 10-24V AC/DC ESIM420
type: Pohony brán, závory / Ovládanie pohonov / GSM (mobilom)
description_html:
ELDES ESIM420 – Intelligent GSM/4G controller for gates and devices

ESIM420 is a universal and reliable controller designed for remote control of sliding and swing gates, barriers, doors, or other electrical devices. Thanks to the support of 2G and 4G networks, the ELDES GATES application, and the possibility of control via call, SMS, or timer, it offers maximum flexibility and convenience.

Why choose ESIM420

This model combines modern GSM/4G technologies with reliable hardware. It allows easy installation, convenient management of up to 2000 users, and flexible access rights settings. Whether it's a family home, company premises, or a residential complex, ESIM420 provides you with control and assurance that your devices will be operated safely and efficiently.

Main features
  • Control without fees – Open the gate or device with a simple call. The call is automatically rejected, so you pay nothing. Unknown numbers are ignored to increase security.
  • User management – Allows storing up to 2000 phone numbers and assigning them access rights according to days and hours. Management is done easily via a computer or mobile.
  • Support for multiple administrators – Up to 5 administrators can change settings, add/remove users, and receive important notifications.
  • Event logs – The device stores up to 1000 records with exact date, time, and caller identification.
  • Automatic actions – Option to set up to 8 time schedules for opening and closing the gate or switching other devices.
  • Flexible control – Control is possible by ringing, SMS message, through a cloud interface, or the ELDES GATES mobile application.
  • Easy configuration – Device settings via SMS or the free ELDES Utility Tool program (USB/GPRS).

Technical parameters

Power supply 10–28 VAC ~ 500 mA / 10–39 VDC, max 500 mA
Standby consumption up to 50 mA
Mobile network 2G 900/1800 MHz; 4G 700/800/900/1800/2100/2600 MHz
Outputs 2× relay, NO/NC configurable; max. 125 VAC 0.5 A / 24 VDC 1 A
Inputs 3× (2× low level 0–16 V, 1× high level 5–50 V)
Memory capacity 2000 users, 5 administrators
Event log 1000 records
Protection IP20 (indoor installation)

Doraz kľučky, samolepiaci – Elegantná ochrana vašich stien
Tento nenápadný, ale vysoko funkčný doplnok je ideálnym riešením pre každú domácnosť či kanceláriu, kde chcete predísť nevzhľadným preliačinám a škrabancom na stenách spôsobených nárazmi dverových kľučiek.

Hlavné výhody:
Jednoduchá inštalácia: Vďaka kvalitnej samolepiacej vrstve doraz upevníte v priebehu pár sekúnd bez nutnosti vŕtania alebo použitia náradia.
Tlmenie nárazov: Mäkký, ale odolný materiál efektívne pohlcuje silu nárazu a výrazne znižuje hluk pri prudkom otvorení dverí.
Univerzálny dizajn: Vďaka minimalistickému vzhľadu a neutrálnemu prevedeniu prirodzene splynie s akýmkoľvek interiérom a typom povrchu (stierka, obklad, drevo).
Dlhá životnosť: Vyrobený z materiálov odolných voči opotrebovaniu, ktoré si zachovávajú svoju pružnosť a priľnavosť po dlhý čas.

Použitie: Interiér (domácnosti, kancelárie, hotely)

title: Heavy duty anchor with countersunk screw
type: Spojovací a kotviaci materiál / Kotvy
description_html:
The Fischer high-performance anchor with countersunk head is a sleeve anchor made of zinc-plated steel. The anchor is set in the time-saving through-type installation. When tightening the anchor, the cone is pulled into the expansion sleeve and expands it against the hole wall. The black plastic ring prevents the anchor from rotating and absorbs the torque slippage. This means that the fixture is pulled towards the anchoring base. The Fischer high-performance anchor FH II SK with countersunk head is ideally suited to fix railings, staircases, and ladders in cracked and non-cracked concrete.

With countersunk head for assembly that is flush to the surface.
The international approvals guarantee maximum safety and maximum performance. Also for applications in earthquake regions (seismic C1 and C2).
The ideal combination of screw shank and sleeve enables a high transverse load capacity and fewer fixing points.
The optimised geometry intelligently reduces the setting energy and thus ensures a force-saving assembly.

title: Hliníková samonosná posuvná brána 6x2,125m s obdĺžnikovou výplňou 20x100, Antracit R7016, s napinákom a pohonom - SET
type: Hliníkové brány a ploty / Hliníkové brány / Hliníkové samonosné brány
description_html:
Hliníková samonosná posuvná brána 6 x 2,125 m, prechod 4,1m, s obdĺžnikovou výplňou 20 x 100, Antracit RAL 7016, s napinákom a pohonom BXV-4-ZKIT – SET

Kód produktu: FG/S-CLG-R7016-GA-SET-PRO

Moderná samonosná posuvná brána pre komfortný a bezúdržbový vjazd
Moderná samonosná posuvná brána predstavuje prémiové riešenie pre vjazd do objektu bez potreby spodnej pojazdovej koľajnice. Vďaka samonosnej konštrukcii sa brána pohybuje nad terénom, čím eliminuje problémy so znečistením, zamŕzaním či opotrebovaním koľajnice. Ide o ideálne riešenie pre intenzívne používanie aj náročné klimatické podmienky.

Brána je vyrobená z kvalitného extrudovaného hliníka EN AW-6063 T6, ktorý zabezpečuje vysokú pevnosť pri nízkej hmotnosti a výnimočnú odolnosť voči korózii v porovnaní s oceľovými systémami. Konštrukcia je navrhnutá pre dlhodobú bezúdržbovú prevádzku bez nutnosti náterov alebo dodatočnej ochrany.

Dominantným prvkom je obdĺžniková latová výplň 20 x 100 mm, ktorá vytvára moderný a čistý architektonický vzhľad pri zachovaní optimálnej miery súkromia. Povrchová úprava práškovým lakovaním v odtieni Antracit RAL 7016 (mat) zabezpečuje dlhodobú farebnú stálosť bez blednutia a olupovania.

Systém je koncipovaný ako samonosná brána s robustným C-profilom, napinákom a zosilnenými pojazdovými vozíkmi kotvenými do betónového základu. Stabilitu zabezpečuje horné vedenie a dorazové prvky, ktoré garantujú plynulý, tichý a presný chod bez kontaktu so zemou.

Automatický pohon BXV-4-ZKIT v cene
Súčasťou setu je moderný pohon BXV-4-ZKIT určený pre samonosné posuvné brány, ktorý zabezpečuje spoľahlivé a komfortné automatické otváranie a zatváranie brány. Set obsahuje aj ROLLKIT sadu s fotobunkami, ktorá zvyšuje bezpečnosť a komfort každodenného používania. Pohon umožňuje jednoduché ovládanie pomocou diaľkového ovládania a zabezpečuje plynulý a tichý chod brány.

Prečo si vybrať práve túto bránu?
Ak hľadáte moderné, spoľahlivé a bezúdržbové riešenie posuvnej brány bez koľajnice, tento systém predstavuje dlhodobo najkomfortnejšiu voľbu. Ponúka vysokú odolnosť, presné spracovanie, kompletný montážny set a jednoduchú inštaláciu bez potreby zvárania.

Kľúčová konkurenčná výhoda
Na rozdiel od klasických koľajnicových systémov je táto brána samonosná, čo prináša:
• bezproblémovú prevádzku aj v zime bez snehu a nečistôt v dráhe
• minimálnu údržbu bez čistenia koľajníc
• tichý a plynulý pohyb
• vyššiu spoľahlivosť pri každodennom používaní

Zároveň je konštrukcia plne skrutkovaná bez zvárania, čo umožňuje:
• vysokú presnosť výroby
• jednoduchú montáž a úpravy na mieste
• možnosť demontáže bez poškodenia konštrukcie

Technické parametre
• max. šírka brány: 6000 mm
• svetlá šírka prejazdu: cca 4100 mm
• max. výška: 2125 mm
• rozmer výplne: 20 x 100 mm
• typ výplne: obdĺžniková latová
• farebné prevedenie: Antracit RAL 7016 (mat)
• typ pohonu: BXV-4-ZKIT pre samonosné posuvné brány
• príslušenstvo: ROLLKIT sada s fotobunkami
• ovládanie: diaľkové ovládanie

Flexibilita na mieru bez príplatkových zásahov
Bránu je možné prispôsobiť skrátením profilov a výplní priamo na stavbe, čo umožňuje presné osadenie a znižuje náklady na individuálne riešenia.

Bezúdržbové riešenie na roky
Kombinácia hliníkovej konštrukcie a nerezových spojovacích prvkov zabezpečuje vysokú odolnosť voči korózii. Brána si dlhodobo zachováva svoj vzhľad aj funkčnosť bez potreby natierania.

Kompletné riešenie v jednom sete
Dodávané vrátane samonosného C-profilu, zosilnených vozíkov, vodiaceho systému, dorazov, napináka, pohonu BXV-4-ZKIT, ROLLKIT sady s fotobunkami a kompletného montážneho príslušenstva – pripravené na okamžitú inštaláciu.

Hlavné výhody
• automatický pohon BXV-4-ZKIT v cene
• ROLLKIT sada s fotobunkami pre vyššiu bezpečnosť
• samonosný systém bez potreby spodnej koľajnice
• vysoká stabilita a dlhá životnosť konštrukcie
• farebná stálosť bez nutnosti ďalších náterov
• jednoduchá výmena komponentov
• rýchla montáž skrutkovým systémom – úspora času aj nákladov
• minimálna údržba – stačí bežné čistenie

title: Jokel column ZnPVC RAL 6005 40x60x2000mm
type: Plotové systémy / Stĺpiky
description_html:
Stĺpik dodávame s čiapočkou.
Rozmer stĺpika : 60x40mm.
Hrúbka steny: 1,5 mm.
Výška: 2000mm.
Povrchová úprava : Zn + RAL6005 zelená.

Všetky stĺpiky z našej ponuky plotových systémov dodávame so štandardnými čiapočkami.

DETAIL PRODUKTU

Oceľové plotové stĺpiky s prierezom 60x40 mm sú spoľahlivým riešením pre montáž rôznych druhov oplotenia, predovšetkým zváraných panelov. Vďaka svojej robustnej konštrukcii, odolnému povrchu a univerzálnosti sú ideálnou voľbou pre zabezpečenie trvácneho a estetického oplotenia.



VLASTNOSTI PRODUKTU

Trvácnosť: Oceľový profil s hrúbkou 1,5 mm zaisťuje vysokú pevnosť a odolnosť voči mechanickému zaťaženiu.
Odolnosť voči korózii: Zinkovaný povrch a práškový náter predlžujú životnosť produktu aj v náročných klimatických podmienkach.
Jednoduchá inštalácia: Možnosť montáže na rôzne typy podkladov – do betónu, alebo na pätku.
Estetický vzhľad: Čisté línie a povrchová úprava v rôznych farbách: Zelená, antracit, hnedá, čierna matná alebo sivá umožňujú zladiť stĺpiky s rôznym dizajnom oplotenia.
Pri montáži do betónu odporúčame stĺpik o 50-70cm dlhší, ako výška vášho oplotenia:

Príprava: Pre dostatočné upevnenie do zeme je potrebné vykopať otvor s hĺbkou cca 50–70 cm, v závislosti od výšky plotu a miestnych podmienok (napr. mráz, typ pôdy).
Umiestnenie stĺpika: Stĺpik osadíte do otvoru a vyrovnáte ho do požadovanej Polohy, pomocou vodováhy alebo laseru.
Betónovanie: Otvor zalejete betónom a necháte stvrdnúť (odporúča sa min. 24 hodín).

description_html:
Modern one-component adhesive, based on MS polymer with immediate fixation and extremely high initial adhesion of up to 500 kg/m2.
Specially developed for gluing without the need to fix the joints - it holds immediately.
It hardens by vulcanizing atmospheric moisture, creating a highly strong, elastic joint.
Instant adhesion up to 500 kg/m2
High ultimate strength of 22 kg/cm2 (220,000 kg/m2)
High modulus
Fast curing, odorless
High adhesion to the substrate - even on matte wet substrates
Permanently flexible, resistant to moisture and water (watertight joint), weather effects
Free of isocyanates, solvents, phthalates and silicone
After hardening, it can be covered with suitable dispersion paints (except alkyd resins).
Glued objects do not need to be fixed. The joints "hold" without the use of clamps and support

Usage:

Gluing structural waterproof joints in the construction and engineering industry.
Bonding in interiors and exteriors of buildings. Gluing of structural parts of cars, buses, caravans, passenger cars. Bonding of bodywork parts - metal to metal (absorbs vibrations).
Bonding of anti-corrosion steel, aluminum, copper, lead, glass, PS, PUR, PVC and some types of plastics, concrete, ceramic tiles, enamel, mirrors, wood, bricks, plasterboard, etc.
Bonding of stairs, window sills, skirting boards, cladding elements, etc.

title: Movable aluminum system – louvered – pair (left + right)
type: Hliníkové brány a ploty / SWING-SHADOW
description_html:
Hliníkový horizontálny naklápací systém 1 090 mm pre žaluziovú výplň 95 × 20 – pár (ľavý + pravý), Antracit RAL 7016

Kód produktu: FG/SWS-1090-AL-R7016

Moderný žalúziový systém z hliníka predstavuje ľahké, odolné a estetické riešenie pre tienenie a ochranu súkromia. Je určený pre lamely s rozmerom 95 × 20 mm a dodáva sa ako kompletný pár (ľavý + pravý diel) pre presnú a symetrickú montáž.

Pevná, no zároveň ľahká hliníková konštrukcia s integrovaným mechanizmom umožňuje plynulé naklápanie lamiel, vďaka čomu jednoducho regulujete množstvo svetla aj prúdenie vzduchu podľa aktuálnych potrieb.

Systém je vhodný pre exteriér aj interiér. Hliník je prirodzene odolný voči korózii, pričom povrchová úprava práškovým lakovaním v odtieni Antracit RAL 7016 (mat) zabezpečuje vysokú odolnosť voči UV žiareniu, poveternostným vplyvom a dlhodobú farebnú stálosť.

Kľúčové vlastnosti

Plynulé naklápanie lamiel – nastavenie od 0° (uzavreté) až po 105°
Ľahká a pevná konštrukcia – jednoduchá manipulácia aj montáž
Vysoká odolnosť – nehrdzavie, vhodné do exteriéru
Bezúdržbové riešenie – bez potreby náterov, stačí opláchnuť vodou
Univerzálne použitie – vhodné pre ploty, brány, balkóny, terasy, zábradlia aj interiérové deliace prvky
Kotvenie lamiel: horizontálne max. dĺžka 1 500 mm

Prečo si vybrať tento systém?

Systém umožňuje efektívne riadiť svetlo, tienenie aj súkromie bez úplného uzavretia priestoru. Pomáha znižovať prehrievanie a zároveň zachováva prirodzené odvetranie.

Vďaka hliníkovej konštrukcii je manipulácia jednoduchšia a zaťaženie konštrukcie nižšie, čo oceníte najmä pri väčších realizáciách.

Hlavná výhoda konštrukcie

Skrutkovaný systém bez zvárania umožňuje presnú montáž, jednoduché skrátenie na mieru, úpravy priamo na stavbe a demontáž bez poškodenia komponentov.

Technické parametre

Dĺžka systému: 1070 mm
Kotvenie lamiel: horizontálne max. dĺžka 1 500 mm
Kompatibilná výplň: 95 × 20 mm
Prevedenie: pár (ľavý + pravý diel)
Materiál: hliník (AL)
Farba: Antracit RAL 7016 (mat)

Výhody

plynulá regulácia svetla a vzduchu
ochrana súkromia bez úplného tienenia
vysoká odolnosť voči korózii a počasiu
dlhodobá farebná stálosť
rýchla montáž bez špeciálneho náradia
bezúdržbová prevádzka
nízka hmotnosť pri zachovaní pevnosti
široké možnosti využitia vďaka modulárnosti

title: Movable plastic system - blinds - pair (left + right)
type: Hliníkové brány a ploty / SWING-SHADOW
description_html:
A modern, lightweight, and durable PVC blind system for slats, designed for variable shading and privacy protection. Thanks to a simple tilting mechanism, the user can easily adjust light intensity and airflow. The system is engineered for both outdoor and indoor use, resists UV radiation and weather effects, and maintains its color and shape even after long-term use.

Key Features
Smooth slat tilting - angle adjustment from 0° (closed), 90° (full ventilation) up to 105°
Lightweight construction - low weight ensures easy handling and installation
Weather resistance - material stabilized against UV, water, and frost
Maintenance-free operation - occasional rinsing with water is sufficient; no painting or impregnation required

Universal Application
Suitable for balconies, terraces, railings, fences, and interior partition walls.

Technical Specifications
Slat width: 95 mm
Slat thickness: 20 mm
Maximum length of aluminium slat: per request, typically up to 2400 mm
Maximum length of wooden slat: per request, typically up to 1500 mm
Operating temperature range: -20 °C to +60 °C

Customer Benefits
Light regulation - improves indoor comfort, prevents overheating
Privacy protection - optimal barrier against outside views
Quick installation - modular design requires no special tools

description_html:
Drive for Swing Gates Wingo 2024

Introducing the Wingo 2024 drive, a model from the Nice brand, designed for swing gates. This drive is ideal for both residential and industrial gates, offering reliable and quiet operation with maximum safety. Thanks to its modern design and advanced technologies, Wingo 2024 ensures easy installation and long service life.

Benefits:

  • Reliability and performance: Wingo 2024 is designed for stable and long-term performance, ensuring safety and reliability in daily use.
  • Quiet operation: This drive is equipped with technology for quiet operation, meaning less noise when opening and closing the gate.
  • Easy installation: Wingo 2024 is easy to install and compatible with various types of swing gates, making it a universal solution.
  • Weather resistance: The drive is designed to withstand various climatic conditions, making it suitable for outdoor use.
  • Safety: Advanced safety features, such as obstacle detection, protect your gate and property.

Key Features:

  • Electromechanical drive: Wingo 2024 uses an electromechanical mechanism that ensures reliable movement of the gate wings.
  • Automatic closing: The automatic gate closing feature after a certain time provides additional convenience and safety.
  • Emergency unlocking option: In case of a power outage, the gate can be manually unlocked.
  • Compatibility with Smart Home systems: Wingo 2024 can be integrated with smart home systems for remote control.
  • Adjustable speed and force: Allows you to adjust the opening/closing speed and force as needed.

These features make Wingo 2024 a great choice for anyone looking for a reliable and efficient drive for swing gates. If you are interested in more detailed information or a price quote, do not hesitate to contact us!
